subject_description: a TV home shopping host shown from the chest up, black suit, white shirt, dark red tie, white made-up face, large black eyes, tiny clip-on microphone on the lapel
initial_pose: body and head turned three quarters to the right, black eyes looking at the camera, both hands raised in front of the chest with the fingertips touching, closed-lip smile
description: laughs without any sound: the shoulders and chest shake hard and the head bobs with laughter, but the face stays exactly the same frozen closed-lip smile and the black eyes stay fixed on the camera; then the shaking stops and he settles back into the starting pose The shoulders stay almost still and never move sideways; the whole body and both hands stay inside the frame.
